turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! First, a worked example.
We eat lunch. My father eats lunch.
"My father" means "he", so I add -s: eats.
Rule: after he, she or it, the verb gets -s or -es.
Right: It sleeps on the bed. Wrong: It sleep on the bed.

Now try. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
